response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, death_country FROM player WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(death_country) <> '') AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM totals) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_totals, AVG(t.total - b.average_total) AS average_excess FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.total > b.average_total

assumptions.assumption: The average total is across all eligible players, regardless of death country.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each player's total with the average for players sharing their death country.
